notes: The age formula gives am ... old to the construct ben and leaves the numerals and the counted noun their own English; the whole-idiom noncompositional reading is named in that unit.
The ASV writes the negation and the modal as two words (no ... can), so rule 35 splits them: lo takes no and yakol takes I can.
Both lameds before the infinitives are unrepresented: the modal's bare complement writes no to (rules 40, 52).
